latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of detox-counter.
- Track any cleanse or detox with customizable counters and duration.
- Log daily symptoms including headaches, cravings, mood, sleep, and digestion.
- Celebrate progress with milestone tracking and visual timelines.
- Supports preset detox types (Sugar, Juice, Whole30, Elimination, Custom).
- Data remains private and is stored locally.
